Conclusion: a pescatarian diet that includes varied seafood plus dairy/eggs is the healthiest, most nutrient-complete and flexible option of the two compared, as long as mercury-heavy fish are limited, whereas a stricter near-vegetarian pescatarian approach gains plant-diet benefits but needs regular fish intake to avoid nutrient gaps.
